name: Misaki Yuuchi
source:
The protagonist's best friend.
His nickname is Zaki. He is a second-year student in the Buddhist Studies Department at the Komainu University.
He is a member of the Zen Meditation Club and has a strong ability to concentrate. He
always confuses those around him with his crazy behavior.
